note: Analyst reading of the news, written from logged events. Not data. The weekly agent replaces it every week. The log is a sample of named events (only 8 of about 70 boat strikes are logged one by one) and nothing is logged after Oct 14, 2026.
headline: On Oct 14 the US removed Jorge Rodriguez, head of the National Assembly, from the sanctions list; a source told Al Jazeera it is part of wider recognition of the interim government and a three-phase transition plan, and Rubio said a new round of negotiations on Venezuela's future began that day (#4066).

On Oct 8 prosecutors added a conspiracy-to-commit-torture charge to the indictment of Maduro and Cilia Flores (#4065). Maduro was captured on Jan 2-3, 2026 (#4049); since then the interim government under Delcy Rodriguez has cooperated with Washington (#4057, #4058, #4063).

Boat strikes continue at a slower pace. The latest logged strike was on Oct 4 and killed four (SOUTHCOM, #4064); Stripes puts the toll at least 235 across 70 strikes since September 2025, with no source named for the totals.

No Venezuelan hostile act (an attack, harassment of US assets or a mobilization) is logged since Nov 16, 2025 (#4034). No new US deployment is logged in 2026; the last is the carrier's entry into the Caribbean on Nov 16, 2025 (#4033).
Small numbers: most options have only a handful of counted cases, the log holds only 8 of about 70 boat strikes, and options F and G are too thin to measure.
pending: Whether the new round of negotiations announced on Oct 14 leads to further sanctions relief or a deal (#4066)
Whether the US keeps striking boats while it deals with the interim government (#4064)
